stories.title: Robert Pattinson is the next James Bond, taking over the spy role from Daniel Craig
stories.summary: After rampant online speculation about who would take over the iconic spy character from Daniel Craig, the franchise announced who the new 007 will be.

stories.title: More than 2.5 million Michiganders expected to travel for Thanksgiving, AAA says
stories.summary: The number of Michigan residents who expect to travel for Thanksgiving has leveled off compared to recent years, but remains extremely high.

stories.title: Sanilac County man dies in 4-vehicle crash in Grant Township
stories.summary: A Sanilac County man died as a result of a multi-vehicle crash on Friday in St. Clair County, deputies said.

stories.title: Michigan Matters: Raising awareness of civics and financial literary in schools
stories.summary: On the heels of a historic election that saw more young folks turning out to vote, three people are laser-focused on raising awareness about the importance of civic literacy.

stories.title: 3 in custody in Royal Oak after vehicle crashes into home during police pursuit
stories.summary: Michigan State Police report three people are in custody in the aftermath of a police pursuit and a vehicle crash into a Royal Oak home.

stories.title: Michigan natives, including CeCe Winans and the late J Dilla, land at least 7 nods at 2027 Grammy Awards
stories.summary: Michigan natives nominated for the 2027 Grammy Awards include Jack White, CeCe Winans, Billy Strings and J Dilla. See the categories and when the Grammys air.

stories.title: Air travel slowly returns to normal after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Air travel is slowly returning to normal following a four-hour nationwide ground stop. CBS News's Jarred Hill reports.

stories.title: Armed carjacking leads to police chase in Royal Oak
stories.summary: Three people are in custody after a police pursuit that began in Detroit and ended in a Royal Oak neighborhood early Monday morning.

stories.title: A timeline of Trump administration's response to FAA ground stop
stories.summary: President Trump was informed within 30 minutes after the Federal Aviation Administration imposed a nationwide ground stop Friday afternoon, according to U.S. officials.

stories.title: North Dakota woman buys Ford Bronco, drives 27 hours home after flights grounded
stories.summary: A woman bought a Ford Bronco and drove 27 hours from Charlotte, North Carolina, back home to North Dakota during the nationwide FAA ground stop.

stories.title: Diesel prices fall below $6 a gallon for the first time since September
stories.summary: Diesel around the U.S. now averages $5.99 a gallon, down from a record high of $6.53 in September, according to AAA.
